verdicts.title: DNF: Unconditional 4D Generation with Dictionary-based Neural Fields
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: While remarkable success has been achieved through diffusion-based 3D generative models for shapes, 4D generative modeling remains challenging due to the complexity of object deformations over time.
